app.title: TenkaCloud Participant Portal
app.no_session: No active session. Please sign in again.
app.mock_cloud_body: This event is using a local mock cloud adapter. No real AWS resources are created.
app.localstack_cloud_body: This event is configured for LocalStack at {endpoint}. Real AWS resources are not used.

errors.auth_expired: Team login key is invalid or the deployment has been deleted.
errors.invalid_url: Invalid URL format (must be an absolute URL starting with http:// or https://).
errors.unknown_slot: This slot is not declared in metadata.
errors.no_endpoints: This problem has no endpoints declared.

home.auth_error_empty_key: Please enter the team login key
home.no_problems_body: This team has no deployed problems. Please contact the operator.
home.quests_quick_link_body: {count} problem(s) deployed. Open the Quests list to start.

login.info_body: Enter the team-level login key shared by your operator. Per-individual accounts are not created.
login.field_description: Short-lived key issued by the operator at problem deploy time

team_setup.title: Choose your team name
team_setup.description: Enter the name to call your team during this event
team_setup.edit_description: Update the name shown on the scoreboard and your profile. Other members of your team will see the new name too.
team_setup.field_description: Shown on your profile and the scoreboard. You can change it later.
team_setup.validation_failed: Invalid team name format. Use 1–40 chars: alphanumeric, space, _, -, or Japanese characters only.

quests.header_description: Catalog of problems deployed to your team. Each card links directly to its access URL.
quests.console_failed_header: Failed to issue AWS Console URL
quests.session_expired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
quests.empty_battle: No problems in the Battle category
quests.empty_challenge: No problems in the Challenge category
quests.empty_hint_all: This team has no deployed problems. Please contact the operator.
quests.empty_hint_filtered: Check other categories under the "All" tab.
quests.empty_unsolved_hint: Solved ones are in the section below.

notifications.header_description: Operator notifications (newest first, max 100, polled every 60 s)
notifications.no_event_body: This team belongs to a legacy deployment not linked to an event, so operator notifications are not delivered.
notifications.empty_hint: Notifications sent by the operator from the application admin console will appear here.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.no_event_header: This team is not linked to an Event
scoreboard.no_event_body: Legacy deployments (pre-Phase 1) do not support event-scoped aggregation.
scoreboard.frozen_body: To prevent last-minute rushes, the ranking is hidden from 30 minutes before the competition ends until the final result is published. The final ranking will be shown after the competition ends.

score_events.title: Score events
score_events.description: Your team's score history (auto-refresh every {intervalSec} s, newest first, up to 100)
score_events.empty_hint: Once the competition starts, score changes from HealthCheck uptime / flag submissions / hint reveals etc. will appear here.

problem_detail.deploy_missing_header: This problem is not deployed to your team
problem_detail.deploy_missing_body: jobId {jobId} is not in your team's deploy list, so details cannot be shown. Please contact the operator.
problem_detail.scoring_not_started_body: This problem is locked until the competition starts. Problem details, hints, and flag submission are inaccessible until then. Please wait for the operator's start signal.
problem_detail.endpoint_description: Switch your team's service URL to a re-hosted target (Lambda / ECS / App Runner, etc.) and the scoring engine will probe that URL. The URL must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL.
problem_detail.endpoint_not_yet_pre: Not retrieved yet — once deploy completes, it will be auto-fetched from CFn Outputs.
problem_detail.endpoint_not_yet_post: If you want to register your own URL now, override it from "Register new URL" below.
problem_detail.endpoint_not_overridable: This slot is not overridable (fixed default URL)
problem_detail.endpoint_error_invalid_url: Invalid URL (must be an absolute URL starting with http:// or https://).
problem_detail.endpoint_error_unknown_slot: This slot is not declared in metadata.
problem_detail.endpoint_error_no_endpoints: This problem has no endpoints declared.

sso_credentials.title: SSO Credentials
sso_credentials.description: One-click federated sign-in to the AWS Console. No personal AWS account needed — access the environment the host prepared, safely from the portal.
sso_credentials.howto_body: Pressing the button below opens the AWS Console (CloudFormation stacks view) in a new tab, already signed in. Session TTL is 1 hour.

cli.body: Issue 1-hour temporary credentials for AWS CLI / boto3 / Terraform usage. Same IAM scope as the Console (ParticipantViewerRole).
cli.expired_note: These credentials have expired. Please re-issue.
cli.security_note: * Credentials are never persisted off-screen. They disappear on reload / navigation. Be careful where you paste — leaks can't be revoked early.

problem_panel.stale_body: {ago} since last scoring. Something in your service may not be responding as expected.
problem_panel.auto_delete_soon_body: Automatic deletion is approaching: about {remaining} remaining ({expiresAt}). Save anything you still need before teardown starts.
problem_panel.auto_delete_expired_body: The automatic deletion time has passed ({expiresAt}). Teardown may already be running or queued.
problem_panel.celebrate_body: You've already solved this problem. Move on to the next!
problem_panel.ok_alert_body: Congratulations. Your total score is {total} pt.
problem_panel.wrong_with_penalty_body: You've made {count} wrong attempts. Check the value and try again. Penalty per wrong attempt is {penalty} pt; total never drops below 0 pt.
problem_panel.wrong_body: Check the value and try again.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_not_started_no_eta: The competition has not started yet. Wait for the operator's start signal.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_not_started_unknown: The competition has not started yet.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_not_started_passed: Competition start time was {startsAt} (already passed). There may be a delay in reflection.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_not_started_remaining: About {minutes} min until competition start (scheduled: {startsAt}). Please wait.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_ended_no_eta: The competition has ended. Scoring gate is closed.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_ended_at: The competition has ended (ended at: {endsAt}). Scoring gate is closed.
problem_panel.scoring_gate_paused: Scoring is temporarily paused. Please contact the operator.
problem_panel.hint_confirm_penalty: Revealing will cost {penalty} pt. This cannot be undone.
problem_panel.hint_confirm_no_penalty: No penalty for this hint. Revealing will display the content.

score_timeline.header_description: Showing all {count} teams in this event
score_timeline.empty_body: No score history yet. Flag submissions and Battle uptime points appear here.
score_timeline.aria_label: Cumulative score timeline of all teams since competition start
